LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Flower.label: Neiyu: Flower Form
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Flower.description: Neiyu's flower armament channels blessings and the toxic garden through glowing petals. Has low melee damage and can change into sword or bow form. Never breaks.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Flower.tools.0.label: Flower Sweep
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Weapon.label: Neiyu: Sword Form
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Weapon.description: Neiyu's sword armament delivers rapid cuts that pierce heavy armor. Can change into flower or bow form. Never breaks.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Weapon.tools.0.label: Neon Blade
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Bow.label: Neiyu: Bow Form
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Form_Bow.description: Neiyu's bow armament. Its main arrow splits into 16 armor-piercing homing shards. Can change into flower or sword form. Never breaks.
LanguageData.MX_Bullet_BigSplitArrow.label: Neiyu: Rending Main Arrow
LanguageData.MX_Bullet_HomingShard.label: Neiyu: Pursuing Feather Shard
LanguageData.MX_Bullet_BarrageArrow.label: Neiyu: Flowfeather Arrow
